known_limitations: Implements a minimal subset of the reviewed requirements focused on core family, child, classroom, attendance, invoice, payment, and waiting-list workflows.
Does not persist data across restarts; all data is in-memory only.
Does not implement authentication, role-based permissions, exports/imports, audit trails, advanced immunization workflows, or phased rollout/training features.
Does not implement multi-site rules, sibling discounts, late fees, prorating, refunds, reversals, or exception approval workflows.
